scripts.build: pnpm --filter @optimus/connectors build && pnpm --filter @optimus/engine build && pnpm --filter @optimus/web build && pnpm --filter @optimus/desktop build
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check
scripts.start: pnpm build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "pnpm --filter @optimus/engine start" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/hello && pnpm --filter @optimus/desktop start"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @optimus/connectors typecheck && pnpm --filter @optimus/engine typecheck && pnpm --filter @optimus/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @optimus/desktop typecheck
